figures.finding: The only statutory pay floor in the Cayman Islands is the national minimum wage, CI$8.75 an hour from 1 January 2026 (CI$6.00 since 2016), which applies across all sectors and to every type of worker; no film agreement or guild sets a performer's pay above it (see blockers).

value.basis: National minimum wage (Minimum Wage Amendment Order 2025), general, not film-specific

figures.applies: Cayman Islands, all sectors, from 1 January 2026.

sources.said: As of 1 January 2026, the minimum wage will increase to CI$8.75 per hour. This applies across all sectors and is not restricted to particular types of workers. This is the first adjustment to the minimum wage since its introduction in 2016
Current minimum wage: CI$6.00 per hour (since 2016)
